defects.note: The translator's note says the chronogram 'anno-fas ftIrpes pan ChreftVs Lege MeDetVr' gives the date 1714. The page states no date. Adding up the capital numeral letters (I+C+V+L+M+D+V) gives 1661, the year of the Lisbon first edition. The invented date is wrong and misleads the reader about when the book was printed.
The page number (33), signature F and catchword 'quo' were dropped from the English apparatus.
